viewing_check: Photograph compressor head and crankcase for a maker or model plate and any serial number; check for oil/water in the pump, hose condition (cracks, perishing, fittings), whether it starts and pumps (pull start), presence of a check valve/filter and regulator mouthpieces (photo 4 shows only connectors). Confirm the hoses are rated breathing-air grade. The engine alone is a reasonable floor value.
